# Statechart: eval-report

Schema: `2.1.0`.
The YAML uses a WORK composite with COLLECT as its initial substate.
WORK owns CANCEL so both children inherit cancellation.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> INIT
    state WORK {
        [*] --> WORK_COLLECT
        state "WORK.COLLECT" as WORK_COLLECT
        state "WORK.REVIEW" as WORK_REVIEW
        WORK_COLLECT --> WORK_REVIEW : DATA_READY [payload.checks_passed === true]
    }
    INIT --> WORK_COLLECT : RUNTIME_READY
    WORK_REVIEW --> DONE : HUMAN_APPROVED
    WORK --> CANCELLED : CANCEL
    DONE --> [*]
    CANCELLED --> [*]
```

| Handler | Signal | Target | Guard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INIT | RUNTIME_READY | WORK.COLLECT | None |
| WORK.COLLECT | DATA_READY | WORK.REVIEW | `payload.checks_passed === true` |
| WORK.REVIEW | HUMAN_APPROVED | DONE | None |
| WORK | CANCEL | CANCELLED | None |

Final markers describe completion, not extra runtime signals.
A failed DATA_READY guard keeps the run in WORK.COLLECT.
No setup, middleware, or flattened replacement states are part of this topology.
